extracted.intended_audience: donors and philanthropists seeking high-impact, cost-effective giving recommendations (and stakeholders interested in GiveWell's funding/allocations)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for identifying, researching, and allocating funding to highly cost-effective, evidence-backed charitable programs; oriented toward donors and funders looking to maximize impact per dollar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost-effectiveness (good accomplished per dollar)
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine how much good a given program accomplishes (in terms of lives saved, lives improved, etc.) per dollar spent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We don’t focus solely on financials, such as assessing administrative or fundraising costs. Instead, we conduct in-depth research to determine how much good a given program accomplishes (in terms of lives saved, lives improved, etc.) per dollar spent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on a small number of outstanding giving opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus on finding and directing funding to a small number of outstanding giving opportunities, not on reviewing as many organizations—or as many causes—as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GiveWell is focused on finding a small number of outstanding giving opportunities, not on reviewing as many organizations—or as many causes—as possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence-backed programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritize programs that are evidence-backed and demonstrably cost-effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We spend more than 70,000 hours each year reviewing academic evidence and researching different programs to identify highly cost-effective, evidence-backed ones. (See also linked pages: Research overview; How we research programs; Cost-effectiveness analyses.)

rubrics_metrics.name: In-depth, research-driven evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Use extensive review of academic evidence and detailed cost-effectiveness analyses to evaluate programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We spend more than 70,000 hours each year reviewing academic evidence and researching different programs. All of the research supporting our funding recommendations is free and publicly available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency and public sharing of research
rubrics_metrics.description: Share research and rationale openly so any donor can access high-quality information to inform impact-based giving.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All of the research supporting our funding recommendations is free and publicly available. We pledged to share our work on the GiveWell website, for free, to help all donors who wanted to do as much good as possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider organizations' funding needs and other donations when allocating funds
rubrics_metrics.description: When allocating pooled donor funds, take into account organizations' funding needs and donations they have received from other sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GiveWell takes zero fees and will apply its judgment to allocate these funds among the organizations we recommend. We take into account organizations' funding needs and donations they have received from other sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocate grants to highest-value funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Make grants to the highest-value funding opportunities identified by research and judgment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We then make grants to the highest-value funding opportunities we can find. Our primary fundraising goal is to raise funds for the outstanding programs we recommend.

rubrics_metrics.name: No fees on donations processed
rubrics_metrics.description: GiveWell does not take fees from donations it processes; operational funding comes from separate unrestricted donors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GiveWell takes no fees from the donations we process. Our funding is covered by donors who give us unrestricted funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure success by amount of money moved to recommended programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess fundraising success by how much funding is directed to the recommended, high-impact programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We measure our success by the amount of money we can move annually to these programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant excess assets rather than hold them
rubrics_metrics.description: If GiveWell raises more than needed for operations, it grants out the excess rather than continue to hold it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If we raise more than we need to support our operations, we grant out the excess rather than continue to hold it ourselves as per our excess assets policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer donor-tailored giving funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide multiple giving fund options so donors with different preferences can give in a way that benefits from GiveWell's research and allocation process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We offer multiple giving funds for donors with different preferences, and strongly believe each of these options is a very impactful way to give. By donating to one of GiveWell’s giving funds, you take advantage of our ongoing research and analysis, ensuring that your gift is allocated to the highest impact giving opportunities that we’ve identified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use organizational judgment in allocation (active grantmaking)
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply GiveWell's judgment, informed by research, when deciding how to allocate pooled donations across recommended organizations and opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GiveWell takes zero fees and will apply its judgment to allocate these funds among the organizations we recommend. We take into account organizations' funding needs and donations they have received from other sources, and then make grants to the highest-value funding opportunities we can find.
